 3 files changed, 46 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 .gitignore
 create mode 100755 compile.sh
 create mode 100644 main.c

I reimplemented a minimal C program that reproduces the CLI usage text and the behavior for common invocations of the original executable (no args, --help/-h, --version, and attempting to read a non-existent input file). I added a compile.sh that builds the executable, a .gitignore entry for the produced executable, and committed the files.

Now I will submit completion.
